summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Air quality across Metro Cebu improved to “fair” levels on Tuesday, October 6, after several days of elevated fine particulate matter (PM2.5) linked to haze from Indonesia.…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Air quality across Metro Cebu improved to “fair” levels on Tuesday, October 6, after several days of elevated fine particulate matter (PM2.5) linked to haze from Indonesia.
